info.title: TackPath API
info.description: Submit delivery orders, follow routes and packages, receive webhooks and read proof of delivery. Guide: docs/api/README.md.

CompanySession.name: X-TackPath-Session
CompanySession.description: The developer page only (a dispatcher company session)

external_id.description: Your order reference. Unique per company: a second order with it is refused (409).

tracking_number.description: The barcode on the package. Generated (TPA...) if omitted. Unique per company; a number already used by another order or on any of the company routes is refused (409).

metadata.description: Your own key/values, returned as is (at most 2 KB)

mode.description: test: created with a test-mode key; never on the dispatch board

status.description: See the status table in the guide

media_pending.description: A photo was taken but has not finished uploading yet

secret.description: Only in the create and rotate-secret responses

key.description: Only in the create and rotate responses

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string (max 200). A retry with the same key and body returns the first response; with another body, 409.
